feeds.title: That's Not My Age
feeds.description: It offers expert advice and tips for women of all ages. I strongly believe that it is not about age, it is about style. That looking good is not about buying loads of new stuff but spending time figuring out what makes you feel chic and comfortable and confident. Follow the blog for a grown-up guide to great style.

feeds.title: My Midlife Fashion
feeds.description: Hi I'm Jane & I live with my husband & teenage son in Worcestershire. A UK based Personal Stylist & Fashion Blogger sharing my OOTD posts & where you can 'shop my style'. In February 2013 in recognition of the year I hit the big Four-0 I took a huge jump outside of my comfort zone to begin this blog about one of my main passions in life. Subscribe to keep track of new posts from this blog.

feeds.title: Edits Styling Blog
feeds.description: Get fashion and styling tips from the Edits Styling Blog. Find out the latest trends and what fashion items can stand the test of time. Edits Styling offers you a unique range of modern image improvement services to help you look fabulous, everyday. Nina Whitehead is a personal stylist, wardrobe and image consultant, she can help you discover and develop your own personal style.

feeds.title: Style by Claire Lopez Blog
feeds.description: Visit the Style by Claire Lopez Blog to get styling tips for various clothing items, how to style outfits for different events and much more. Claire is a highly qualified personal stylist and blogger with nearly twenty years' experience in the fashion industry. Having completed a Diploma in Personal Styling from the London College of Style in 2015, she has since built up a successful styling business with a diverse and ever-expanding client base.

feeds.title: Francesca Allen Blog
feeds.description: The Francesca Allen Blog gives you outfit ideas for different seasons and events. Get to know the latest trends and how to style yourself. With a love for style, Francesca worked in fashion for many years gaining experience working with high street brands and developing her own sense of style. Francesca took the leap and studied Personal & Fashion Styling with The London College of Style and there began her personal styling career.

feeds.title: One of a Style
feeds.description: Welcome to One of a Blog, here you can find personal stylist tips and the newest fashion trends. My name is Stefania, the Founder and Head Stylist. My style story starts in Florence, a city where fashion is the air we breathe. Having trained in Fashion Design, and spent 10 years working in the industry, I came to London to share my Italian style secrets and passion for self-expression through One of a Style.

feeds.title: My Personal Style Blog
feeds.description: Nicola Davis is a multi award-winning Colour Me Beautiful personal stylist based in Hampshire offering individual and group colour, style and make-up consultations to make you look and feel fabulous. Visit her blog - My Personal Style to get the best styling advice and much more.

feeds.title: Deni Kiro Blog
feeds.description: Find out the latest fashion trends, what to wear that best suits you and much more styling advice with the Deni Kiro Blog. Deni Kiro provides a range of personal styling, personal shopping, and wardrobe makeover services for both men and women. She has been working as a personal stylist & image consultant for the last 9 years with clients of all different backgrounds.

feeds.title: Natasha Itzcovitz Blog
feeds.description: Check out the blogs written by Natasha, including styling tips, advice, fashion news and reviews. All her articles are free to read. Based in London, Natasha is a fashion stylist providing Personal Styling services for everyone.

feeds.title: Always Stylish Blog
feeds.description: Personal Stylist and Fashion Designer Lisa O'Shaughnessy based in London shares her fashion tips and style advice for women. She styles men, women, LGBTQ+ and teens from a wide range of industries including: tech, law, media, people in the public eye, medicine, property, finance, interns, C-Level directors to helping new mum's and dad's reclaim their style.

feeds.title: The Stylist And The Wardrobe
feeds.description: My name is Joanne Hegarty and I'm a London based fashion journalist turned blogger and stylist gun to hire. Here on The Stylist And The Wardrobe you will find lifestyle and fashion posts to ponder and hopefully enjoy.

feeds.title: Charlotte Loves Blog
feeds.description: Charlotte is a corporate and personal stylist with 18 years experience in the beauty and fashion industry. Let me boost your image!

feeds.title: GlamRosie
feeds.description: Diary of a bargain hunting, fibre composition obsessed, shopaholic Mummy & Personal Stylist!

feeds.title: Estilistas Blog
feeds.description: Check out the Estilistas to learn how to have the perfect style for work, a party or any other occasion. We want to make it easier than ever for you to shop consciously. We help you find your style and the perfect clothes and accessories - items you'll love. Estilistas is a fashion styling service to help you achieve the style and wardrobe you want.

feeds.title: Buddy and Noo Blog
feeds.description: The Buddy and Noo blog gives you advice on lifestyle, styling, sustainability, confidence and fashion. Hello! I'm Alice, Personal Stylist and founder of Buddy & Noo. My business aims to help women discover their own unique style and grow their confidence through their wardrobes in an easy and sustainable way.

feeds.title: Niki Whittle Blog
feeds.description: Thee Niki Whittle Blog gives you advice on styling your outfits and how to maintain a capsule wardrobe. Fashion and style advice blog by Online Personal Stylist, Niki Whittle. With 17 years experience Niki shares tried and true tips and advice to stop you wasting money on disappointing clothes, by helping you dress your shape and put outfits together that look good on you, so you enjoy getting dressed.

feeds.title: Laura Fawcett Blog
feeds.description: Laura Fawcett is a Stylist, Shopper & Image Consultant based in Leeds, York and Harrogate. Specialising in casual dressing, occasion wear and corporate styling. She has over 15 years experience in the fashion and makeup industry working closely with a wide range of clients for different occasions and lifestyles. Check out her blog to know how to be sustainable with your wardrobe and shop responsibly.

feeds.title: STYLED BY SUSIE Blog
feeds.description: The Styled By Susie Blog provides tips on personal styling and how to stylish with what you wear. Styled By Susie is a friendly and affordable personal styling service, helping women with their confidence by dressing for their body shape and colouring.

feeds.title: Styled By Sian Blog
feeds.description: Read my latest style tips, time hacks, and shopping tricks for style inspiration that will save you precious time.My name is Sian Clarke and I am Personal Stylist based in London. I am a colour analysis expert, wardrobe stylist, and personal shopper. I specialise in body shape style, wardrobe edits, and shopping for clients.

feeds.title: Sterling Style Academy Blog
feeds.description: Sterling Personal Styling is a Luxury Online Personal Shopper & Online Personal Stylist Blog for Men and Women. From certifying personal stylists to inspiring you to develop your own signature style, our mission is to educate you on style.

feeds.title: The Fashion Style File Blog
feeds.description: Discover top style tips for women with curves, highstreet product picks, outfit ideas, personal stylist tips, brand reviews, and much more at the fashion style file blog by London-based personal stylist and shopper Jas Chana. Jas' mission is to help you look and feel great in your clothes. No matter what body insecurities you may have, her aim is to guide you to express your unique personality through your clothes and style yourself with confidence.

feeds.title: Gabrielle Teare Blog
feeds.description: Gabrielle Teare is the Leading London Personal Stylist and Personal Shopper based in heart of shopping in Chelsea London.

feeds.title: Style Me Flawless Blog
feeds.description: Style Me Flawless brings you style articles, tips and wardrobe advice. I'm Numba Pinkerton. With over 10 years experience in the style and fashion industry, I am known for my insightful expertise on all aspects of style and colour, as well as creating stylish wardrobes with pieces that easily co-ordinate with each other.

feeds.title: The Styling Storey Blog
feeds.description: Want style tips, advice and brand suggestions that will help you get out of a style rut? Then come read Loulou Storey's blog. Loulou has had the privilege of doing what she loves for the last 19 years. Working with women from all over the world to find their style & to unleash their power through their clothing.

feeds.title: Chantelle Znideric Blog
feeds.description: Chantelle Znideric Blog is where you can find shopping tips, personal styling tips, fashion week updates and a lot more. Hi, I'm Chantelle, an Award-Winning Personal Stylist and Shopper, with 15+ years experience. I work with successful women transitioning through the menopause with busy lifestyles, who feel stuck in a rut with their style, overwhelmed with their existing wardrobes and lacking in confidence with knowing what suits them.
